message.content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[R184]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The game has poor controls that are frustrating to use.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Everything about this game is surprisingly terrific, except the controls. Love it!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R187]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The game cannot be zoomed in on small screens, making it hard to see details.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Beautiful, but can’t zoom in"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R188]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The game is too short and ends quickly, leading to disappointment.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "just can't give it 5 stars because... it's way too short. It's so lovely, creative, challenging, and satisfying but I finished it over the course of 3 episodes of Below Deck: Mediterranean. What an amazing experience it would be to play this daily."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R192]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The game is easy to play with great controls and relaxing gameplay.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "LOVE this game! I love the way they made this game. It’s easy to play, the controls and views are great, i love the concept and levels, the graphics are great."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R193]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The tutorial is too difficult to understand, making it hard to know how to play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Two stars because I don’t know how to play this game the tutorial so difficult"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R202]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The controls are clumsy and do not help when stuck, leading to frustration.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It is nice but clumsy and when you are stuck, there is no clue. So I am at a point where the second orange plate is missing and nothing goes forward. Very frustrating!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R203]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The controls are fine but sometimes grab the wrong brick when trying to rotate one.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "the controls weren’t the greatest thing about this game. They were fine except I found myself grabbing different brick when I was trying to rotate one."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R207]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The game lacks zoom support for smaller displays like the iPhone 6s Plus, making it hard to see details.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Otherwise, it’s a terrific game! My only other suggestion is for supporting people with smaller displays. The ability to zoom in would help on those older devices (like an iPhone 6s Plus)."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R210]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The controls are described as really bad and frustrating despite the good graphics and concept.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Controls! Great graphics & idea. Reaaally bad controls. & I’m not one to complain about controls."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R215]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The 'hold to place' mechanic is unintuitive and often nonresponsive, causing thumb cramps.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The “hold to place” mechanic is not at all intuitive (I keep trying to tap to place? or something?) and half the time I find it nonresponsive, and the camera often feels quite limiting. Doing anything with speed (I’m stuck on a mud level rn) is finicky and difficult. If just a few of the control things were tweaked I’d be raving, but as of now I just have a thumb cramp."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R226]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The 'long press to place' functionality is inconsistent and straining on the fingers.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Controls feel very clunky. The \"long press to place\" functionality is frustratingly inconsistent and straining on the fingers."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R228]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "The controls are clunky and difficult to move pieces, and the view rotation is useless.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Poor controls. This is a very nice puzzle game, cute and I liked guessing what to do in each level. However, the controls are clunky and difficult to actually get pieces where you want them, and you can’t actually rotate your view, despite it appearing as if you can (you get a bit of rotation as long as you aren’t actually trying to do anything; in other words it looks cool but is useless)."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R200]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "The game is free to play but lacks sufficient content, prompting requests for more levels.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "More Please!!! I absolutely loved this game It was challenging and fun!! I love the graphics and the storyline I’ve gotten though it twice now and I need more!!   Please make more levels and characters please!!!❤️❤️❤️"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R203]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "The game is too short and lacks enough gameplay to justify extended play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Not enough gameplay. I downloaded this game thinking that I would get hours of game time but, I have beat it twice within the span of an hour. I would appreciate different modes or a changeable story."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R207]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "The game is too short and ends quickly, leading to disappointment.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Super Enjoyable, A Little Short. As an adult, I still enjoy LEGO’s. It helps that I have kids, of course. This game takes me right back and makes me want to build all over again just by myself. The pixels are great, the haptics are a nice touch, and the story is sweet. I wish it were a little longer because I finished it in just a few hours."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R208]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "The game is extremely short and ends too quickly, with no new levels added.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Talk about Short! I really love LEGO anything but man is this game SHORT! What is the point if you don’t add new levels? Like one Critic said, “I just got the hang of it and it’s OVER! MORE PLEASE!!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R222]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "The game does not save progress properly, resetting to the beginning after closing.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Good concept, bad saving. I had gotten to maybe the 2nd to 4th area when I turned off my iPad to do something else. When I came back my progress had been reset. I decided to keep playing and got a lot farther on. I was feeling satisfied so I again stopped playing for a few hours. When I opened the app again I was at the beginning of the mud part. I was really annoyed at this point. I decided to delete the app."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R223]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "The game lacks sufficient levels or content, with users requesting more levels or sequels.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Incredible! Surprising find. Please make more levels or a part II and III and IV..."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R224]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "The game ends too quickly, lasting only about 45 minutes of gameplay.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Gorgeous! This game is beautiful. The graphics are stunning, the details are amazing and the game play is elegant. The only criticism is that it ended too quickly. All in about 45 minutes of game play"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R225]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "The game is well-crafted but ends too quickly, lasting less than one sitting.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Excellent, but a little too short. I thoroughly enjoyed playing this. As a lego fan myself, building my way through this adventure was filled with moments of wonder and awe. It brought me back to easier, less complicated days. I would continue to play but alas, you can literally finish it in less than one sitting."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R226]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "The game is shallow and can be completed in less than two hours with no replay value.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Beautiful but shallow. Great looking game that feels mostly like a proof of concept. The puzzles never become truly challenging and the game can be completed in less than two hours with no real replay value."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R227]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "The game is too short and users want more levels or content added.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Too good but too short. This is one of and maybe even the best Apple Arcade games. The graphics were amazing and the soundtrack was beautiful. It touched me when the dad had to leave and I cried. But it was way too short. Please add more levels and I will add my final star."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R228]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "The puzzles are too easy and aimed at very young children, like 4-year-olds.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Graphics are nice, but the puzzles are for 4 year olds. The graphics are amazing! Too bad the puzzles are actually for 4 year olds. Put the triangles in a square shape. Match the colors. It get monotonous before too long."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R229]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "The gameplay is unclear and lacks defined goals, making it feel like a demo rather than a game.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Great graphics but I’m not sure why. Is this a game, a puzzle, or a demo? I am very impressed with the graphics but the gameplay isn’t clear and the goals are never mentioned."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R219]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "The gameplay lacks clear goals and hints, leading to boredom and disengagement.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Great graphics but I’m not sure why. Is this a game, a puzzle, or a demo? I am very impressed with the graphics but the gameplay isn’t clear and the goals are never mentioned. You can zoom and pan the board you’re playing, but as soon as you take your finger off of the screen, it snaps back to its original position. This make continued gameplay kind of boring and tiresome. I’m at level 3 and I need to do something, but I’m not sure what, and honestly I no longer care."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R209]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "The camera controls are limited and need improvement, such as zoom and rotation.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "So far it’s fun but camera controls still need work. Not sure if I’m missing something but it desperately needs a way to zoom in. Can’t see what I’m doing half the time so if there’s a way to zoom in and rotate the camera please let me know"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R216]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The game has bugs that cause pieces to fall off the board and puzzles to repeat endlessly without feedback.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Bugged out. At one point a piece fell off the board and the puzzle was unsolvable requiring me to restart the level. At another point I am presented with 4 spots and 4 identical orange pieces and the puzzle just repeats endlessly without feedback or clues. The puzzles don’t really rotate and the interface seems clumsy."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R222]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The game has a poor saving system that resets progress when the app is closed.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Good concept, bad saving. I had gotten to maybe the 2nd to 4th area when I turned off my iPad to do something else. When I came back my progress had been reset."
    }
  ]
}
